message: War table check: we’re sitting at **9,933 fame**, and the early movers today are **JaxikoLane, King Thing, 66, and raquaza** — clean work, keep the pace. Donation crown goes to **Chanco (308)** with **raquaza (282)** and **JaxikoLane (258)** right behind; that’s the kind of daily fuel that keeps POAP KINGS sharp. If you’re on the “not yet” list, grab your 4 war decks and get them in — I want this race decided by volume and discipline.
